# Stream and stream chargeback.md

> [!info] From project: [[_Project Info|Timelog FIB]]

September 5, 2025, 12:45 AM

To: Chargeback Services, First Interstate Bank

From: Alan Nguyen

Date: 09/05/2025

Account Number: 5527 4761 1194 8043

Subject: Dispute Submission \- Steam & Stream (Invoice INV-008290, $18,000 Payment)

---

Dear Chargeback Services,

I am submitting this formal dispute package regarding the above transaction. This packet includes all required documentation and demonstrates unequivocally that:

1. No signed agreement exists. The only governing document is the Invoice INV-008290 (attached), which specifies a fixed fee of $18,000 for property acquisition, setup, and listing optimization of two properties. No hourly rates, prorated refunds, or post-payment contracts were agreed to.

2. Failure of deliverables. The program promised property acquisition within 2–3 weeks and $3,500+/mo profitability within months 1–2. After 11 weeks, no property was acquired, no setup was performed, and no listings went live \- a complete failure of consideration.

3. Improper billing practices. The merchant retroactively attempted to impose $45/hr charges (129.5 hours \= $6,257), which were never disclosed or agreed. Under UCC §2-209, FTC Act §5, Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act (Tex. Bus. & Com. Code §17.46), and Visa Core Rule 13.3.1, this constitutes misrepresentation and billing outside agreed terms.

4. Consumer protection violations. Misrepresentation of expected profits ($3,500+/mo in months 1–2 vs. their later claim of “break even”), delayed fulfillment, and post-payment contract attempts all qualify as deceptive practices under FTC and Visa regulations.

---

### **Attached Exhibits**

* Exhibit A: Invoice INV-008290 (Steam & Stream) \- shows fixed-fee scope .

* Exhibit B: Text messages to Jerome (Aug 21, 2025\) \- cancellation and refund request, citing missed timelines and profit misrepresentation.

* Exhibit C: Merchant email (Aug 21, 2025\) \- admission of delays, Zi-Find failure, and attempt to impose hourly billing .

* Exhibit D: My formal response (Aug 21, 2025\) \- asserting lack of signed agreement, failure of consideration, and legal protections.

* Exhibit E: Follow-up clarification email (Aug 22, 2025\) \- further confirming inefficiency, refusal of consent to landlord outreach billing, and reaffirming refund request.

---

Requested Relief:

I request a full refund of $10,500 USD (remaining balance of $18,000 paid, less $7,500 already refunded) to be credited back to my Visa account.

The merchant’s refusal to refund despite clear non-performance constitutes wilful noncompliance with Visa’s Core Rules and consumer protection laws.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,

Alan Nguyen
